approval_ref: Continue improving CIRP efficiency, accuracy and adaptability across RFI, Submittal and Email content.
notes: Reproduce a drawing identifier assembled from components belonging to two cited sheets.
Validate explicitly written Sheet, Drawing and Dwg identifiers as atomic values before generic numeric checks.
Keep a claimed drawing identifier with the same exact RFI/Submittal identity or source finding.
Allow an exact Sheet locator to ground only its own identifier.
Normalize prefix variants, case and dash glyphs only; do not infer unlabelled codes, applicability, revision or authority.
title: Ground project-answer drawing identifiers
objective: Prevent an explicit drawing identifier from being recombined or borrowed across workflows, source findings or exact Sheet locators in a project-file answer.
